title: Viewing your financial account activity: Tuition amount and payments
content_markdown:
> Please note:  
> – Your Account Activity will only display a record of the payments you have made to your account\. Receipts for payments made in TouchNet are available in TouchNet\.  
> – Your Account Activity does not refresh in real time\. Tuition and student fees are assessed nightly\.

## How to view your account activity

### Go to your Finances app in Workday

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](http://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\. 
2.  Select “Student” in the navigation bar on the left\. 
3.  Select “Finances”\.

### View summaries of outstanding and upcoming charges

Two tables on the “Finances” page show details about amounts due:

1.  The “Amount Due by Academic Period” table shows any total amounts due and the Academic Period they are owed from\.
2.  “Due Date Summary” shows amounts due on specific dates\.

[Due date summary on Finances App](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/09/Financial-account-activity_1-1-940x461.png)

### Review your account activity

Click the “View Account Activity” link in the “Tuition and Fees” menu on the right side of the page\. 

On the “Account Activity” page, your Account Summary displays:

-   Your Name
-   Institution
-   Your **Total Account Balance:** This is the total amount you owe on your account\. This may include payments due now and payments due at a later date\.
-   Your **Due Now** Balance**:** This is the sum of your current and overdue charges \(if any\) that you need to pay now\. Any anticipated payments, like your sponsor or award payments, will not be included in this balance\.
    -   Note: If you wish to pay though TouchNet, you can not pay more than 30 days in advance\.
-   You may not see any ‘Charges’ until you register in courses\.

#### Transaction Summary  

Your “Transaction Summary” will be displayed in a table below your Account Summary\.

The “Transaction Summary” table contains your transactions, charges, payments, and financial aid listed in order of transaction date, from all academic periods\. Your most recent transaction will be listed at the top\. Each transaction lists the transaction date, the due date, and a description\. 

#### Due Now Details

The “Due Now Details” tab at the top of the table displays a summary of : 

-   **Past Due Charges**: These are charges that have passed their payment due date\. 
-   **Current Due Charges:** These are charges that are due within the next 30 days\.
-   **Anticipated Payments**: These are funds that you expect to receive, but are not deposited in your account yet\. this may include assigned awards or sponsorship payments for which a contract has been received and added to your account\.
-   **Unapplied Payments:** This is the total of payments made in an academic period that were not used for any of your charges\.
    -   Please [contact your Enrolment Services Advisor](https://students.ubc.ca/about-student-services/enrolment-services-advisors/) to request to have these funds applied to charges in an upcoming term\.  

Click the dollar amount link to learn more about your charges or payments\. A pop\-up window listing the individual charges or payments will appear\.

title: Paying your tuition and student fees with pre-authorized debit (PAD)
content_markdown:
You can pay your tuition and student fees by accessing the TouchNet payment tool through Workday\. Pre\-authorized debit \(PAD\) is one of the ways you can pay your tuition\. 

To pay with PAD, you will need a chequing or savings account at a Canadian financial institution or bank\. You can find your banking information, like your Institution Number, Transit Number, and Account Number, in your online banking account information\. Contact your financial institution for support if you are unable to locate this information\.   

Learn more about [paying tuition and fees](https://students.ubc.ca/finances/tuition-fees/paying-tuition/)\.

> **Important information about paying with pre\-authorized debit \(PAD\)**  
> – Please note: UBC PAD is a **one\-time debit only\.** UBC does not automatically withdraw funds from your bank account through pre\-authorized debit to pay the balance you owe\. Once your account is set up, you must **initiate every PAD transaction** to make a payment\.   
> – While PAD payments are reflected in Workday after the payment is completed, funds will  not be withdrawn from your bank account immediately\. Please ensure you have sufficient funds in your bank account until the PAD payment has been withdrawn\.   
> – [Receipts](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/finances/paying-your-tuition-and-student-fees-in-touchnet-pre-authorized-debit/#receipt) for payments made in TouchNet are only available in TouchNet, not in Workday\.

**On this page:**

-   [How to set up your pre\-authorized debit](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/finances/paying-your-tuition-and-student-fees-in-touchnet-pre-authorized-debit/#set-up) 
-   [How to pay with pre\-authorized debit](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/finances/paying-your-tuition-and-student-fees-in-touchnet-pre-authorized-debit/#pay) 

## How to set up your pre\-authorized debit

### Go to your Finances app in workday

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](http://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\. 
2.  Select “Student” in the navigation bar on the left\. 
3.  Select “Finances”\. 

### Go to your TouchNet Payment Profile

1.  Select the “Make a Payment: TouchNet Payment Centre” link in the “Tuition and Fees” menu on the right\. 
2.  Re\-enter your CWL username and password if prompted\. 
3.  Select “Payment Profile” from the dropdown list in the “My Profile” tab\.   
    [Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/Setting-up-pre-authorized-debit_payment-profile-940x342.jpg)

### Add a new payment method

1.  In the “Payment Profile” page, select “CAD Pre\-Auth Debit” \(Canadian dollar pre\-authorized debit\) from the dropdown list in the “Add New Payment Method” section\.
2.  Click the “Select” button next to the dropdown list to save your selection\.  
    [Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/Setting-up-pre-authorized-debit_add-new-payment-method-940x525.jpg)
3.  Enter your banking details and billing information in the pop\-up window \(please **enable pop\-ups** in your web browser\)\. 
    -   If you want this to be your default payment method, check the “Set as your preferred payment method” box\. 
4.  Click the “Continue” button\. 
5.  Read the payment agreement\. 
6.  The terms and conditions will be displayed in the next window\. Review the information and check the “I Agree” box\. 
7.  Click the “Continue” button\. 

### Review or update your pre\-authorized debit information

1.  Select “Payment Profile” from the dropdown list in the “My Profile” tab\. 
2.  Click the gear icon in the “Action” column: 
    -   **Edit**: Review your banking details to confirm they are correct and/or update your payment information 
    -   **Delete**: Remove the payment method\.  
    -   **Set as preferred**: Set the account as your preferred default payment method\.  

## How to pay with pre\-authorized debit

### Review your current outstanding balance

1.  Follow the [steps above](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/finances/paying-your-tuition-and-student-fees-in-touchnet-pre-authorized-debit/#finances) to go to your Finances app in [Workday](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\. 
2.  Review your “Due Now” balance under “Account Activity” on the left\. This balance includes charges that are past due or due within the next 30 days\. 
    -   If there are any changes in your registration, program of study or citizenship on your account, your account balance will be updated the following day\. Your Account Activity does not refresh in real time\. 
    -   You can make payments towards your “Due Now” balance, but not for charges due in the future\. 

### Go to the TouchNet Payment Centre

1.  Select “Make a Payment: TouchNet Payment Centre” in the “Tuition and Fees” menu on the right\. 
2.  Re\-enter your CWL username and password if prompted\. 

### Make a payment

1.  Click the “Make Payment” button\. 
2.  Enter the amount you want to pay in the field under “Due Now”\. You have the option to make a full or partial payment\.   
3.  Click “Continue”\. 
4.  Select “CAD Pre\-Auth Debit” from the “Method” dropdown list\.   
    -   If you’ve previously designated your pre\-authorized debit bank account as your default payment method, you’ll be directed straight to the “Account Payment” screen to pay with this option\. 
    -   You can change the payment method by clicking the “Change Payment Method” button under “Selected Payment Method” in the next screen\.  
5.  Click the “Continue” button\. Follow the prompts to complete your payment\. 
6.  Confirm your payment information, payment amount, and the terms of use on the “Confirmation” screen and click the “Submit Payment” button\. 
    -   You’ll notice your payment is made to a UBC Vancouver campus address\. All payments go through central finance on the Vancouver campus\. 

### Download your receipt

1.  Select “Payment History” from the dropdown list in the “My Account” tab\. 
2.  Select “View report”\. 
3.  Click the gear icon in the “Receipt” column to print the desired receipt\. 

### View your payment in Workday

1.  Follow the [steps above](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/finances/paying-your-tuition-and-student-fees-in-touchnet-pre-authorized-debit/#finances) to go to your Finances app in [Workday](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\. 
2.  Refresh your browser\. 
3.  “Due Now” balance will be updated to reflect your payment\. 
4.  Click the “View Account Activity” link in the “Tuition and Fees” menu on the right to view your payment in the Transaction Summary\. 
5.  Optional: Download your [proof of tuition payment](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/finances/downloading-your-proof-of-tuition-payment-account-statement/) \(Account Statement\)\.

title: Paying your tuition and student fees in TouchNet: TransferMate payment
content_markdown:
## About TouchNet

UBC uses TouchNet as a payment tool for tuition and student fees\.

TouchNet is replacing other forms of ePayment, such as International Funds Transfer via Convera and Interac Online\.  

Receipts for payments made in TouchNet are only available in TouchNet, not in Workday\.

Please note that your TouchNet profile reflects your legal name\.

### Transfermate 

TransferMate is a third\-party service enabling international students without a Canadian bank account to pay tuition in their local currency via bank transfer or credit card\. 

With TransferMate, you have the flexibility to pay through bank transfer as well as country\-specific methods, including:

-   AliPay \(China\)
-   China UnionPay \(Asia Pacific\)
-   Trustly \(EU\)
-   ICICI \(India\)
-   PayNow \(Singapore\)

#### Price Matching in TransferMate

If a student can find a better rate from a similar provider within 2 hours of completing a transaction through TransferMate, they can email [rateassurance@transfermate\.com](mailto:rateassurance@transfermate.com) within 1 month to receive suitable compensation for the price difference, subject to [terms and conditions](https://www.transfermate.com/best-rate-assurance-for-bank-transfers/)\.  

## How to pay with TransferMate

### First, go to your Finances App  

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](http://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\.
2.  On the right side of the page, in the “Your Top Apps” menu, click the “Finances” app\.

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/Go-to-your-finances-app.jpg)

### Review your current outstanding balance

In the Finances app, you will be taken to the “Finances” page by default\. 

On the left side of the page, under “Account Activity”, your “Due Now” balance will be listed\. This balance includes charges that are past due or due within the next 30 days\.

If there are any changes in your registration, program of study, or citizenship on your account, your account balance will be updated the following day\. Your Account Activity does not refresh in real time\. Tuition and student fees are assessed nightly\.

You can make payments toward your “Due Now” balance, but not charges due in the future\.

You may not see ‘Charges’ until you register in courses\.

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/WD-Outstanding-Balance-Before-Payment-1-940x272.jpg)

### Next, go to TouchNet Payment Centre

In the “Tuition and Fees” menu to the right, click the “Make a Payment: TouchNet Payment Centre” link\. You will be redirected to the TouchNet homepage, which is a separate app from Workday\.

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/Go-to-TouchNet.jpg)

### Make a payment 

1.  Once on the TouchNet homepage, you will see your current outstanding balance listed as “Due Now” in the Student Account box\. Click the dark blue “Make Payment” button\.

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/TouchNet_TransferMate-payment_make-payment-940x306.jpg)

2.  On the “Account Payment” page, enter the amount you want to pay in the field under “Amount Due”\. You have the option to make a full or partial payment\.
3.  Click the blue “Continue” button to the lower right\. 

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/TouchNet_TransferMate_enter-amount-940x530.jpg)

4.  For the “Method” field, if you’ve previously designated your pre\-authorized debit bank account as your default payment method, it will be automatically chosen\. However, you can click the light blue “Cancel” button and select “TransferMate INTL” from the “Method” dropdown list\.
5.  Click the dark blue “Continue” button to the lower right\.  
    
    [Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/TouchNet_TransferMate_method-of-payment-940x480.jpg)
    

6.  In the dropdown list, select the country you are paying from\.
7.  Click the blue “Review Rate” button for the rates and payment methods available for the country you have selected\.  
    
    [Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/TouchNet_TransferMate_enter-country-1-940x502.jpg)
    

8.  On the next page, select a payment option\.
9.  Click the blue “Enter Details” button to proceed\.  
    
    [Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/TouchNet_TransferMate_review-rates-1-940x598.jpg)
    

10.  On the next page, enter your payer details\. 
11.  Check the “By clicking this box, I agree to the TransferMate Student Term of Use” box to agree to the TransferMate Terms and Conditions\. You must check this box to complete your payment\.
12.  Click the blue “Continue to Confirmation” button\.

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/TouchNet_TransferMate_terms.jpg)

13.  On the next page, review your payment details\.
     -   If your details are correct, click the dark blue “Initiate Payment” to proceed with your payment\.
     -   If your details are incorrect, click the blue “Back” button to edit your details\. 

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/TouchNet_TransferMate_review-and-initiate-payment-940x646.jpg)

14.  The instructions for completing your payment will appear in a pop\-up window\.
     -   Read the instructions carefully and print or screen capture them for reference\. You will also receive an email with instructions to complete your payment\.
     -   Follow the instructions to make your payment\.
     -   Click the blue “Close” button when you’re done\.

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/TouchNet_TransferMate_instruction-for-payment.jpg)

### If you choose to make your payment later

Any payment made through TouchNet will appear on your TouchNet homepage under “Pending Alternative Payments” until you’ve completed the payment to TransferMate\.

Follow the provided instructions from the previous step to complete your payment\.

If payments are not made within the time limit indicated in the instructions, the payment will be canceled in TouchNet\. No transactions will appear in Workday until payment is complete\.

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/05/TouchNet_TransferMate_pending-payment-940x383.jpg)

### Confirm your payment

After completing your payment to TransferMate, keep any receipts as proof of payments\.   

Once your payment has been received, it will be updated in your “Account Activity” on the Finances page within [Workday](http://www.myworkday.ubc.ca/)\.

title: Downloading your proof of tuition payment (Account Statement)
content_markdown:
Your Account Statement shows your balance and all transactions, like payments and charges, for one academic period and is available for downloading while you are a current UBC student\. Your Account Statement can be used as your proof of tuition payment\.

## How to download your Account Statement

### Go to your Finances App in Workday

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\.
2.  Select “Student in the navigation bar on the left\.
3.  Select “Finances”\.

### Next, go to your Account Statement

1.  In the “Tuition and Fees” menu to the right, click the “View Statement” link\.
2.  A pop\-up window will appear\. From the drop\-down list, select the academic period you want to generate the Account Statement for\.
3.  Click the “OK” button\.

### Download your Account Statement

1.  On the “View Statement” page, click the “Generate PDF” button\.
2.  It may take a moment for the PDF to be generated\. Once ready, click the download icon in the upper right corner of the statement\.
3.  Click “Download”\.

## Additional resources

-   [Viewing your financial account activity: Tuition amount and payments](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/finances/viewing-your-financial-account-activity-tuition-amount-and-payments/)

You will not be able to change your course to Credit/D/Fail on your own in Workday\. You must contact your [Academic Advisor](https://students.ubc.ca/enrolment/academic-learning-resources/academic-advising) to request the change in grading basis\.

To request to change your course to Credit/D/Fail, contact your [Academic Advisor](https://students.ubc.ca/enrolment/academic-learning-resources/academic-advising)\.

title: Understanding course waitlists
content_markdown:
A waitlist may be set up in [Workday](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/) when a course section is full\. If you try to register in a course that is full **and** has a waitlist, you will be added to the waitlist until a seat becomes available for you to register\. 

Learn more about course [waitlists and what to do if a course is full](https://students.ubc.ca/enrolment/registration/register-courses/#get-ready-for-registration)\.

Before proceeding:

-   You can [add yourself to a waitlist for individual courses](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/adding-yourself-to-the-waitlist-for-an-individual-course-section/) or [add a course waitlist to your saved schedule](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/viewing-your-waitlisted-courses/)\. 
-   If a course has multiple course activities \(e\.g\., a lecture and a lab\), the waitlist generally applies only to the **graded course activity** \(typically the lecture\)\. 
-   When a waitlist is active, **non\-graded activities** like labs will show zero available seats\. You can only register in a non\-graded course activity after you are offered a seat in the graded course activity\. 
-   Adding yourself to a waitlist **does not guarantee** that you will be able to register in the course\. You will only be able to register in the course if you receive an invitation to register once a seat opens\. 
-   To join a waitlist, you must meet any course registration requirements that are [viewable in the course section details](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/viewing-the-course-schedule/), including any prerequisites and corequisites\. Learn more about prerequisite and corequisite courses in the [Academic Calendar](https://vancouver.calendar.ubc.ca/)\. 

## How to check if there a course section has a waitlist

### Navigate to the course schedule  

Follow the instructions to view the [course schedule\.](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/viewing-the-course-schedule/)

### Review the section status

Once you’ve found the course section you want, check the section status in the line below the section title\. 

-   If the section status is **“Waitlist”**, then a waitlist has been opened for that course section\. 
-   If the section status is **“Open”**, you can register directly into the course if you are eligible\. 
-   If the section status is **“Closed”**, then the course is full\. 

### View the waitlist capacity

Courses with a waitlist will also show a “Waitlisted/Waitlist Capacity” below the section title\. 

“Waitlisted/Waitlist Capacity” refers to the number of students currently on the waitlist and the maximum number of students who can be on the waitlist\. For example, a “Waitlisted/Waitlist Capacity” of 17/500 means that there are currently 17 students on the waitlist, and the waitlist can hold a maximum of 500 students\. 

[Waitlist capacity, open or closed](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/05/waitlist-details-1.png)

## Additional resources

-   [Creating, viewing and registering from a saved schedule](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/creating-viewing-and-registering-from-a-saved-schedule/)

title: Reviewing your UBC award offers
content_markdown:
Award offers are reviewed in the Learner Financial Support Management \(LFSM\) system, which can be accessed via Workday\. 

The LFSM only includes offer letters for awards from Winter 2024 onwards\. 

Learn more about [claiming UBC scholarships](https://students.ubc.ca/finances/tuition-fees/paying-tuition/#sponsorship-billing)\. 

## Before you review your award offers

Take the following actions in Workday if you haven’t already:

1.  Confirm that [your direct deposit details](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/finances/setting-up-your-direct-deposit/) are set up to receive a “Student Refund”\. If you do not sign up for direct deposit, any remaining funds will remain on your UBC tuition account as a credit towards future tuition\. 
2.  Confirm that your [Social Insurance Number  \(SIN\) or Individual Tax Number \(ITN\)](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/adding-your-social-insurance-number-sin-or-international-tax-number-itn/) are correct\. Ensure this information is added by January if you aren’t able to add it now\.

## How to review your award offers

### Go to your Finances App in Workday

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\. 
2.  Select “Student” in the navigation bar on the left\. 
3.  Select “Finances”\. 

### Review your award offers

1.  Select the “Learner Financial Support Management” link in the menu on the right\. 
2.  Click on an award listed in the “Offered Awards” section at the top of the page\. 
    -   If you hover over the “i” information icon in the Award Description column, you can read the award description\. 

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/07/Reviewing-award-offer_review-and-hover.jpg)

3\.The following options will appear as buttons at the **bottom of the page**\. Select a button to respond to your award offer: 

-   **Accept** 
-   **Decline** 
-   **Accept in reduced amount:** accept a reduced amount to meet your existing scholarship or funding package requirements\. 
-   **Accept in title only:** you will not receive the funding, but the award name will still be included in your award history\. 

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/07/Reviewing-award-offers_award-options.jpg)

4\.  A pop\-up window will appear \(please **enable pop\-ups** in your web browser\)\. Read the instructions in detail\.  
5\. Click the “Download PDF Award Notice and Legal Agreement” link\. Please review the information in the document, including how you’ll receive the award funds\.   
6\. Check each checkbox\. Make sure you’ve carefully read each statement\.   
7\. Depending on your selection: 

-   **Accept:** Select the “I agree” button\. 
-   **Accept in reduced amount:** Fill in the selected amount, write your reason, and then select the “I agree” button\. 
-   **Accept in title only:** Write your reason and then select the “I agree” button\. 
-   **Decline:** Write your reason and then select the “I decline” button\. 

### Review your decision

Once you have confirmed your decision for your award offer, the pop\-up window will disappear\. Your award history will be displayed in the bottom section of the page under “Award and Financial Assistance”\. 

## Next steps

After accepting your award offer, [view your award payments](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/finances/viewing-your-award-payments/) in Workday\.

title: Viewing your award payments
content_markdown:
## About award payments

Once you [accept a UBC award](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/finances/reviewing-your-ubc-award-offers/#accept-offer) in the Learner Financial Support Management \(LFSM\) application, it will be displayed in Workday as an “Anticipated Payment”\. 

After UBC has deposited your award amount towards your outstanding tuition or student fees, it will show up in Workday as an “Applied Payment”\.

## How to view your award payments

### Go to your Finances app

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](http://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\. 
2.  Select “Student” in the navigation bar on the left\. 
3.  Select “Finances”\.

### Go to your account activity

Click the “View Account Activity” link in the “Tuition and Fees” menu to review: 

-   Anticipated Payments 
-   Applied Payments

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/07/Viewing-award-payments_go-to-account-activity-940x270.jpg)

#### Anticipated Payments

“Anticipated Payments” are funds that you expect to receive but have not been deposited in your account yet, like sponsorship or award payments\. 

1.  On the “View Account Activity” page, click the “Due Now Details” tab above the “Transaction Summary” table to display a summary of your charges and payments\. Learn more about your [charges and payments](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/finances/viewing-your-financial-account-activity-tuition-amount-and-payments/)\.
2.  Click the blue dollar amount link in the “Anticipated Payments” field to learn more about your upcoming payments\. A pop\-up window listing all anticipated payments will appear\.

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/07/Viewing-award-payments_anticipated-payments.jpg)

3.  Your anticipated payments will reflect the award amounts you have accepted\. 

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/07/Viewing-award-payments_anticipated-payments-table-940x350.jpg)

#### Applied Payments

“Applied Payments” are award payments that have been deposited to your account\. 

When you open the “View Account Activity” page, your Transaction Summary will be displayed by default\. If you have just reviewed your Due Now Details, click back to the “Transaction Summary” tab to view your award payments\. 

Your transaction summary will be displayed in a table\. Your most recent transactions will be listed at the top\. 

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2024/07/Viewing-award-payments_applied-payments-940x440.jpg)

-   [Viewing your financial account activity: tuition amount and payments](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/finances/viewing-your-financial-account-activity-tuition-amount-and-payments/)

title: Downloading your Program Completion Letter
content_markdown:
Things to be aware of:

1.  If you have an active hold on your student record, you may not be able to request a letter\. 
2.  If you have more than one credential granting program at UBC, you must print one letter per academic record\. 
3.  Your Program Completion Status indicates the type of Program Completion Letter that is available to you\.

Signed Program Completion Letters are available to students in any credential granting program who:

1.  Have graduated from a credential granting program, or; 
2.  Applied for graduation, and have one of the following program completion statuses: 
    -   Evaluation Deferred 
    -   Approved for Completion 
    -   Program Completed

- **Row 1**

  - **Header cell 1:**
  
    Program Completion Status
  
  - **Header cell 2:**
  
    Status details
  
  - **Header cell 3:**
  
    Details included in the Program Completion letter

- **Row 2**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    Evaluation Deferred
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    This status will appear until all final grades are in and your file has been approved by the Dean of your faculty
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    Upon successful completion of all courses in progress \[student name\] will have satisfied all requirements for the following at the University of British Columbia: \[educational credential\(s\) and Program\(s\) of Study\]   
      
    The credential will be awarded \[conferral date\]\.

- **Row 3**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    Approved for Completion
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    Your Program Completion Application has been approved by your faculty\. The status will change to “Program Completed” when Senate meets to approve graduates and confer their degrees during its regular monthly meeting about a week before graduation ceremonies\.
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    This is to confirm that \[name of student\] has completed all requirements for the following at the University of British Columbia: \[educational credential\(s\) and Program\(s\) of Study\]\.   
      
    Subject to the approval of the Senate, this credential will be officially conferred in \[conferral date month\]\.

- **Row 4**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    Program Completed
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    Your degree has been conferred \(awarded\) by Senate and your credentials will appear on your Program Completion letter\.
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    This is to confirm that \[student name\] has completed all requirements for the following at the University of British Columbia: \[educational credential\(s\) and Program\(s\) of Study\]\.   
    This credential was conferred on \[conferral date\]\.

> If you require proof of enrolment or verification of enrolment download a [Confirmation of Enrolment Letter](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/student-documents/downloading-your-confirmation-of-enrolment-letter/) from the [UBC Official Documents tool \(ODMT\)](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/ubc-official-documents)\.

## Access the UBC Official Documents Tool \(ODMT\)

Current and former UBC students can order official transcripts and download unofficial transcripts of their academic record from the [UBC Official Documents tool](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/ubc-official-documents) \(ODMT\)\.

Current students can log into the ODMT directly, or through Workday: 

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](http://myworkday.ubc.ca/%22%20/t%20%22_blank)\. 
2.  Select “Student” in the navigation bar on the left\. 
3.  Select “Academics”\. 
4.  In the “Transcripts and Enrolment/Completion Letters” menu, click the “UBC Official Documents” link to go to the UBC Official Documents tool \(ODMT\)\. 

## How to download a Program Completion Letter

1.  Select “Program Completion Letter” in the “Order Options” menu\.
2.  Select the program you want to request a Program Completion Letter for\.
3.  **Optional:** Select the UBC Student Number and/or Date of Birth box\(es\) if you wish to have this information included in the letter\.
4.  Select “Request Letter \(PDF\)”\.
5.  Wait a few seconds before selecting “Generate Letter \(PDF\)”, as there might be a short delay while the letter is being generated\.
6.  Select the “PDF” icon to download\.

title: Applying to the UBC Bursary Program
content_markdown:
> **Before you proceed:**  
> Before starting the application, make sure the **time zone in your LFSM settings is set up as \(UTC\-08:00\) Pacific Time \(Canada/Pacific\)\.** If your time zone is incorrect, the system may display an incorrect bursary deadline\. The deadline indicated on the [UBC Bursary Program webpage](https://students.ubc.ca/finances/awards-scholarships-bursaries/ubc-bursary-program/#application-period) takes precedence:  
>   
> 1\. Log into [lfsm\.ubc\.ca](http://lfsm.ubc.ca/)\.  
> 2\. Select the circle icon in the top right corner\.  
> 3\. Select “Settings”\.  
> 4\. Confirm that your time zone is correct\.  
> 5\. Select “Save changes”\.

## Go to the bursary application

Current UBC students can apply for the bursary program by logging into the Learner Financial Support Management system directly at [lfsm\.ubc\.ca](http://lfsm.ubc.ca/)\. 

Current students can also access the application through Workday: 

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\. 
2.  Select “Student” in the navigation bar on the left\. 
3.  Select “Finances”\. 
4.  In the “Learner Financial Support Management” menu, click the “Learner Financial Support Management” link\. 

## Complete the bursary application

1.  Click on the waffle menu in the upper right corner\. 
2.  Select “LFSM\-Award Application”\.   
    [Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/08/Bursary_1.2-940x477.jpg)
3.  Click on the \+ button in the upper right corner to start a new Financial Profile: UBC Bursary application\. This Financial Profile is the award application for the UBC Bursary program\.   
    [Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/08/Bursary_2.2-940x98.jpg)
4.  A pop\-up window will appear \(please **enable pop\-ups** in your web browser\)\. 
    -   You can navigate through each section by clicking the section title in the left menu\.  
5.  Read the “Welcome” section and select the checkbox\. 
6.  Read the “Before you Apply” section and select the checkbox\.
7.  In the “Bursary Cycle” section, select the bursary cycle you are applying for to start your bursary application\. For example, 2026 Winter Session, 2027 Summer Session, etc\.\. 
8.  After selecting the bursary cycle to start your application, the left menu will display all the sections of the bursary application\. 
9.  Complete all sections of the application or select the “Save Draft” button if you wish to complete it later\. 
10.  Once you have completed all sections of the UBC Bursary application, read through the terms and conditions and select the declaration checkbox\. 

To continue a draft application or make changes to your UBC Bursary application, go to the LFSM\-Award Application homepage and click the pen icon\. You will be able to continue editing your application until the application deadline\. If you do not complete and submit your bursary application, it will not be considered\.

title: Ordering official transcripts and downloading unofficial transcripts
content_markdown:
> **Before proceeding**:  
> – If you are logging into the UBC Official Documents tool \(ODMT\) for the first time, you might have to wait three hours for your information to sync before you can proceed with the order\.  
> – It takes at least 24 hours for official transcripts to be updated with changes\. This includes grade changes, course adjustments during or after the add/drop deadline, or updates to your contact information \.

Learn more about [ordering official and unofficial transcripts](https://students.ubc.ca/enrolment/records/ordering-transcript/)\. 

## Access the UBC Official Documents tool \(ODMT\) 

Current and former UBC students can order official transcripts and download unofficial transcripts of their academic record from the [UBC Official Documents tool](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/ubc-official-documents) \(ODMT\)\.

Current students can log into the ODMT directly, or through Workday: 

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](http://myworkday.ubc.ca/%22%20/t%20%22_blank)\. 
2.  Select “Student” in the navigation bar on the left\. 
3.  Select “Academics”\. 
4.  In the “Transcripts and Enrolment/Completion Letters” menu, click the “UBC Official Documents” link to go to the UBC Official Documents tool \(ODMT\)\. 

## How to order an official transcript 

1.  Select “Official Transcript” in the “Order Options” menu 
2.  Enter requester and recipient details: 
    -   Enter an email in the “Requester Email” box\. 
    -   Click “Add Recipient”\. 
3.  Select “Recipient Type”: 
    -   “Institution” allows you to select from a drop\-down menu of institutions\. When selected, the institution’s details will populate below\. 
    -   If you don’t see the institution that you are looking for, choose “Other” to fill in details manually\. 
    -   Note: Some institutions allow sending e\-transcripts directly to the institution through Education Planner BC\. Institutions who have this service, will have “e\-transcript” noted beside their name in the dropdown list\.
4.  Select the “Delivery” type\. 
    -   If you select “Print”, select the “Delivery Option” and enter/confirm the delivery details\. 
    -   If you select “Email PDF”, enter an email address in the “Email” box \. 
5.  Review “Print/Email PDF” details and submit the request\. 

### Enter payment details

1.  Review order details\. 
2.  Click the “Proceed to Payment” button\. 
3.  Review payment options \(American Express, China UnionPay, Discover, Mastercard, Visa\)\.
4.  Enter your payment information\. 
5.  Review the confirmation details\. 
6.  Select “Continue”, and the “Payment Success” page will be populated\. You may click the “ID” link to view the order details\. 

## How to download an unofficial transcript

1.  Select “Unofficial Transcript” in the “Order Options” menu\. 
2.  Enter your student number in the “Order Unofficial Transcript” window\. 
3.  Click the “Request Unofficial Transcript \(PDF\)” button\. 
4.  Wait a few seconds before clicking the “Generate Unofficial Transcript \(PDF\)” button\. There might be a short delay while the transcript is being generated\. 
5.  Click the “PDF” icon to download\.

title: Applying for graduation and program completion
content_markdown:
**If you are a graduate student, follow the Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies [Workday How\-to Guides](https://www.grad.ubc.ca/workday-student-support)**

To graduate from UBC, you must complete a formal application process that consists of two components: 

1.  [**Graduation Application**](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/graduation-management-application) 
    -   This application must be submitted to receive your parchment and to indicate whether or not you plan to attend the ceremony\.
2.   [**Program Completion Application**](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/) 
    -   This application must be submitted to have your program requirements reviewed by your faculty or school, and have your degree conferred \(awarded\) by the Senate\. 

**You must complete both the Graduation Application and the Program Completion Application or you will not be eligible to graduate\.** 

Learn more about [applying to graduate](https://students.ubc.ca/enrolment/graduation/applying-graduate/)\. 

**On this page:**

1.  [Step 1: Submit the Graduation Application](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/degree-planning/applying-for-graduation-program-completion/#step-1-submit-the-graduation-application)
2.  [Step 2: Submit the Program Completion Application](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/degree-planning/applying-for-graduation-program-completion/#step-2-submit-the-program-completion-application)
3.  [Step 3: Verify your Application](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/degree-planning/applying-for-graduation-program-completion/#step-3-verify-your-application)
4.  [Step 4: Submit your Program Completion Questionnaire \(may be required\)](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/degree-planning/applying-for-graduation-program-completion/#step-4-submit-your-program-completion-questionnaire-may-be-required)
5.  [Late Applications](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/degree-planning/applying-for-graduation-program-completion/#late-applications)
6.  [Additional resources](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/degree-planning/applying-for-graduation-program-completion/#additional-resources)

## Step 1: Submit the Graduation Application

### Go to the Graduation Application

1.  Use your CWL to log into the [Graduation Application](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/graduation-management-application)\. 
2.  Select ‘Apply for Graduation’ to start your Graduation Application\. 

### Complete your Graduation Application

-   Some of the fields on the Graduation Application will be prepopulated with information from your [Workday](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/) account\. Review this content\. 
-   If graduation ceremony dates and times have not been assigned, you may see an error message and your graduation ceremony details will not appear\. This will not impact your application\. Details may not be available until May \(Spring Convocation\), November \(Fall Convocation\) and are subject to change\. You can also view the [graduation schedule](https://graduation.ubc.ca/schedule/) for updates\.

### Submit your Graduation Application

1.  To submit your Graduation Application, you **must select the “Save & Submit” button** located after the “Ceremony Details” section\. 
2.  If your Graduation Application was successfully submitted, you will see a screen that states “Application Successfully Submitted”\. 
    -   You will also receive a confirmation email sent to the primary email address you have listed in Workday\. Reminder: Please check your Spam and Junk Email folders\.

## Step 2: Submit the Program Completion Application

### Go to your Academics app

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](http://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\. 
2.  Select “Student” in the navigation bar on the left\. 
3.  Select “Academics”\.

### Go to Graduation

On the “Academics” page: 

1.  Click the “Graduation” tab in the top menu\. 
2.  Click the “Apply for Program Completion” link in the “Graduation” menu to the right\. 

### Complete your Program Completion Application

On the “Apply for Program Completion” page, confirm your Academic Record\.

-    If you only have one Academic Record, this field will be prepopulated\.
-   If you have more than one active Academic Record, select the one you are applying for\.

[Select apply and confirm, and enter expected completion date, then submit\.](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2025/12/ECD.png)

1.  **Check the “Apply” box** to select your primary program of study\. Only your primary program of study can be selected in this application, but you will graduate with all of your ‘In Progress’ programs of study\. If you have more than one program of study, make sure your secondary programs are correct before submitting your application \(e\.g\., if you have a minor or a second major\)\. You can view your [programs of study](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/degree-planning/adding-a-program-of-study-second-major-or-minor/?login) in your Academics Overview in Workday\. 
    -   Once your application is submitted, you will **not** be able to make changes to your program of study\. 
2.  Enter your **Expected Completion Date \(ECD\)** according to the conferral period you are applying for: 
    -   **May Graduation**: Enter any date in term 2 \(between January 1 and April 30\) 
    -   **November Graduation**: Enter any date in the Summer Session \(between June 1 and August 31\)
        -   The ECD date entered does not impact your academic record or the date you actually meet/met program requirements\. 
        -   If you select an ECD that does not match the current application window when you are applying, you will receive an error message\. Refer to the application periods and expected completion dates listed above\. 
3.  Check that the information is correct\. If it is correct, check the “Confirm” box\. 
4.  Click the “Submit” button\. 

### Review and confirm your Program Completion Application

1.  Review your “Program Completion Status” to make sure your application was successful\. Your status should read “Applied for Completion”\. 
    -   Contact [graduation@ubc\.ca](mailto:graduation@ubc.ca) immediately if there are any errors\. 
2.  Click the “Done” button\. 

## Step 3: Verify your Application

1.  Use your CWL to log into the [Graduation Application](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/graduation-management-application)\. 
2.  Select “View Details” to open the Application Details screen\. 
3.  Confirm that you have successfully completed both the Graduation Application and the Program Completion Application, by reviewing the “Graduation Application Submitted” and “Workday Program Completion Status” display bars at the top of the screen\. 

**Please note that it may take up to 24 hours for the Application Details to reflect that both applications have been completed\.** 

If there are any discrepancies or changes needed to your Graduation Application, you will be able to edit your application until the application period is completed\. Select “Edit Student Application” from the Application Details screen\. 

**Stages of your application** 

-   Your “Workday Program Completion Status” display bar will update on the Application Details screen when your application has been reviewed and when your degree has been conferred\. 
-   If graduation ceremony dates and times have not been assigned, you may see an error message and your Graduation Ceremony details will not appear\. This will not impact your application\. Details may not be available until May \(Spring Convocation\), November \(Fall Convocation\) and are subject to change\. You can also view the [graduation schedule](https://graduation.ubc.ca/schedule/) for updates\.

### **Viewing your Program of Study Status and your Program Completion Status in Workday** 

In the Workday Academics app, under the “Graduation” tab, you can view your Program of Study Status and Program Completion Status\. There are a number of statuses that may appear on your academic record once you have applied to graduate\. [Learn more](https://students.ubc.ca/enrolment/graduation/graduation-faq/)\. 

## Step 4: Submit your Program Completion Questionnaire \(may be required\)

After submitting your Program Completion Application, you will receive the Program Completion Questionnaire sent to your “My Tasks” inbox in [Workday](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\. 

The Program completion questionnaire is optional unless you have outstanding transfer credits \(courses taken at another institution\) that need to be added to your record to meet degree requirements\. In this case, you must submit a Program Completion Questionnaire\. 

1.  Click the “My Tasks” icon at the top right of the page\. Alternatively, you can select the task on the Workday landing page under “Awaiting Your Action”\. 
2.  Click on the inbox notification titled “Apply for Program Completion Event” to open the questionnaire\. 
3.  Complete the questionnaire by selecting “Yes” or “No” for the question\. 
4.  Review your answer before proceeding\. Once you submit, you will not be able to make changes or view your response\. 
5.  Click the “Submit” button\. 

## Late Applications

If you miss the graduation application deadline, follow your Faculty’s process to request a late application\. Contact your [advising office](https://students.ubc.ca/enrolment/academic-learning-resources/academic-advising)\.

title: Ordering a parchment (diploma) or certified copy
content_markdown:
### Access the Official Documents tool \(ODMT\)  

Current and former UBC students can order official parchment \(diploma\) or certified copy from the [UBC Official Documents tool](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/ubc-official-documents) \(ODMT\)\.

Current students can also log into the Official Documents tool through Workday:

1.  Log into your Workday account at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](http://myworkday.ubc.ca/)\. 
2.  Select “Student” in the navigation bar on the left\.
3.  Select “Academics”\.
4.  In the “Transcripts and Enrolment/Completion Letters” menu, click the “UBC Official Documents” link to go to the UBC Official Documents tool \(ODMT\)\.

### Request a replacement parchment \(diploma\)

1.  Select “Replacement Parchment” under “Order Options”\.
2.  Complete the mandatory fields:
    -   Requestor Email
    -   Credential
    -   Name on Diploma
3.  The “Recipient” fields will appear after the “Name on Diploma” is selected\. Enter the recipient details:
    -   The “Delivery Type” will default to Print\.
    -   If you choose “Pick up” as a delivery option, the address will default to the “Enrolment Services” address\.
4.  **Optional**: Add certified copies to the order\. If certified copies are requested, a replacement parchment must also be ordered\.
5.  Click “Proceed to Summary”\.

### Review the order summary

Confirm that the details of the order summary are correct and click through to proceed to the payment screens\.

### Enter payment details

1.  Review the confirmation details\.
2.  On the “Payment Success” page, you can click the “ID” link to view order details\.

## Additional resources

-   [Ordering and downloading transcripts](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/student-documents/ordering-a-transcript/)
-   [Downloading your program completion letter](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/student-documents/downloading-your-program-completion-letter/)

title: Navigating Workday
content_markdown:
UBC students use [Workday](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/) and the [UBC Official Documents tool \(ODMT\)](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/ubc-official-documents) to complete essential tasks like: 

-   Viewing the course schedule 
-   Registering for courses 
-   Accessing your final grades 
-   Updating your personal information 
-   Paying your tuition 
-   Downloading important documents such as transcripts

[Log into Workday](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/)

[Log into ODMT](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/ubc-official-documents)

> **UBC applicants**  
> [Workday](https://myworkday.ubc.ca/) is a tool for current UBC students\. If you’re an undergraduate applicant who has not yet been admitted to UBC, please log into the [Applicant Service Centre](https://myapplication.ubc.ca/) to access your application status and information\.    
>   
> **Former students and alumni**  
> Former students and alumni can use the [UBC Official Documents tool \(ODMT\)](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/ubc-official-documents) to download and order documents\. [Learn more\.](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/navigating-workday/#odmt)

## On this page

-   [How to log into Workday](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/navigating-workday/#workday)
-   [Your Workday homepage](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/navigating-workday/#homepage)
-   [Downloading documents](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/navigating-workday/#odmt)

## How to log into Workday

Log into Workday at [myworkday\.ubc\.ca](http://myworkday.ubc.ca/) with your Campus\-wide Login \(CWL\)\. 

-   If you have forgotten your login information, you can go to your [CWL myAccount portal](https://www.myaccount.ubc.ca/myAccount) to manage your Campus\-Wide Login\. [Learn more](https://it.ubc.ca/services/accounts-passwords/campus-wide-login-cwl)\. 
-   If you are a new undergraduate student and have accepted your offer, but have not created a **Student CWL**, [follow the instructions](https://it.ubc.ca/services/accounts-passwords/campus-wide-login-cwl/how-create-account) under “**Student Accounts \(CWL Account Upgrader\)**”\. 

## Your Workday homepage

Watch the video below to learn how to navigate to important apps and features on the Workday home page\.

[Embedded content: Kaltura Player](https://api.ca.kaltura.com/p/161/embedPlaykitJs/uiconf_id/23451096?iframeembed=true&entry_id=0_aw5jzfnh&config%5Bprovider%5D={%27widgetId%27:%270_q2rpbvmd%27})

### Sidebar navigation menu

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/01/UX-Whole-Page-1_Dashboard-768x475.png)

The sidebar navigation menu located on the left of the homepage contains links to important apps and features within Workday\. 

### Student

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/01/UX-Focused-View-1_Student-768x514.png)

Select the **“Student”** menu category to find the two Workday apps that are related to: 

-   **Academics:** Where you can view the course schedule, create a saved schedule, register for courses, and more\. 
-   **Finances:** Where you can view your tuition and fees, download your account statement, access TouchNet to make a payment, setup your direct deposit, and more\. 

### Personal

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/01/UX-Focused-View-2_Personal-768x514.png)

Select the **“Personal”** menu category, then select **“Personal Information”** to view and edit your home contact information, personal information, preferred name, and more\. 

If you are a student who is also employed by UBC, you may see additional apps that are related to your employment\. 

### Your profile

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/01/Workday_Profile-768x432.png)

In your profile you can view and edit select information\. To access your profile: 

1.  On the Workday homepage, click your user icon in the top right corner\. 
2.  Click the “View Profile” button in the pop\-up menu\. 
3.  View: 
    -   **Summary:** Contains your student ID and class standing\. 
    -   **Personal:** Add your [preferred name](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/updating-your-preferred-name/), [pronouns](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/updating-your-pronouns-trans-experience-and-gender-identity/), [SIN, ITN](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/adding-your-social-insurance-number-sin-or-international-tax-number-itn/), [Third Party Authorization](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/adding-your-third-party-authorization/), and [Indigenous self\-identification](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/updating-your-indigenous-self-identification/)\. You can also view your [legal name](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/viewing-your-legal-name/) and [date of birth](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/viewing-your-date-of-birth/)\. 
    -   **Contact:** Add personal [contact information](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/adding-changing-your-contact-information/) and [emergency contacts](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/adding-your-emergency-contacts/)\. 

### Tasks and notifications

[Image](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/01/Workday_notifications-768x433.png)

Select the **“My Tasks”** **inbox** icon in the top right or an item in the **“Awaiting Your Action” section** to view your tasks\. Examples of tasks include completing registration for a waitlisted course and Workday onboarding\. 

Select the **“Notifications”** icon in the top right to view your notifications which may include updates to program change requests, waitlist status, and changes to your residency status\. 

## Downloading UBC documents

Current and former UBC students can use the [UBC Official Documents tool \(ODMT\)](https://ubc.appiancloud.com/suite/sites/ubc-official-documents) to download and order documents this includes: 

-   Official and unofficial transcripts 
-   Parchments \(diplomas\) 
-   Program Completion Letters 
-   Tax forms \(T2202 and T4A\) 
-   Confirmation of Enrolment letters \(current students only\) 

Current students can also log into ODMT through Workday in the Academics app\. 

View step\-by\-step tutorials on [downloading documents in ODMT](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/student-documents/)\.

title: Creating, viewing, and registering from a saved schedule
content_markdown:
There are two primary ways you can register for courses in Workday\. You can [register for individual courses](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/registering-for-individual-course-sections/) one at a time, or you can create a saved schedule and register for **all your courses at once**, which is covered in the tutorial below\. 

---

**Before proceeding:**

-   **Creating a saved schedule does not register you in courses\.** You must follow separate instructions to:
    -   [register from a saved schedule](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/course-registration/creating-viewing-and-registering-from-a-saved-schedule/#register)\.
    -   [register in a waitlisted course](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/joining-viewing-and-registering-from-course-waitlists/)
-   For the Winter Session, you must make a saved schedule for each term\. We recommend starting with Term 1\. 
-   When creating a saved schedule, you can only add courses that are offered in the same academic period \(Winter Term 1, Winter Term 2, Summer Session\)\. Courses that span Term 1 and Term 2 will only appear in the Term 1 saved schedule\. If you register in a course that spans both terms, be mindful of course conflicts in Term 2\. Learn more about [resolving course conflicts](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/troubleshooting-your-course-registration/)\.  
-   When you are building **your Term 2 saved schedule**, you may see an alert that you do not meet the prerequisites for some courses\. This may be because you have the **prerequisites on your Term 1 saved schedule**\. Check your Term 1 saved schedules to make sure you have the required courses to meet your Term 2 prerequisites\.
    -   If you complete the prerequisite that triggered the alert, or register in the Term 1 prerequisite, the alert will no longer appear\. As long as there are no other registration issues you will be able to proceed with registration\.
-   You will be able to create your saved schedule with courses from any academic level, but you may not be able to register if you do not meet the eligibility requirements\. 
-   If you have more than one academic record \(e\.g\. concurrent Master’s degree and PhD students\), you need to make a separate saved schedule for each academic record\. 

---

On this page:

-   [How to create a saved schedule](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/course-registration/creating-viewing-and-registering-from-a-saved-schedule/#create)
-   [How to edit a saved schedule](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/course-registration/creating-viewing-and-registering-from-a-saved-schedule/#edit)
-   [How to register in courses from a saved schedule](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/course-registration/creating-viewing-and-registering-from-a-saved-schedule/#register)

## How to create a saved schedule

1.  On the Workday homepage, click the “View My Saved Schedules” button\. 
2.  Click the “Create Saved Schedules” button 
3.  Enter a **name** for the saved schedule and select an **Academic Period**\. 
    -   If you have more than one academic record \(e\.g\., concurrent  Master’s degree and PhD students\), select the academic record you are creating the schedule for\.  
    -   **Tip:** Since you can create as many saved schedules as you wish, it can be helpful to identify the academic year and term in the name to avoid confusion \(e\.g\., “2026W Term 1 First Choice”\)\.  
    -   **Reminder:** You must make a separate saved schedule for each Academic Term\. Courses that span Term 1 and Term 2 will only appear in the Term 1 saved schedule\. 
4.  Select “Ok”\. 

### Select courses to add to your saved schedule

1.  Search for a course using the search box and/or; 
2.  Use the filters to narrow down your search by Academic Level, Delivery Mode, Meeting Days, etc\. 
3.  Click on the down arrow beside a course name to expand it\. You can view the required course activities \(e\.g\. lecture, lab, discussion, etc\.\), grouped by activity type\. 
4.  Click on the: 
    -   “i” icon to view **course section details**\. Please note that add/drop deadlines are not included here\. View the course schedule to find the add/drop date for course sections\. 
    -    “\+” icon to **add** a course to your saved schedule\. 
    -   trash can icon to remove a course from your saved schedule\. 

[Saved schedule builder calendar overview](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/04/icons.png)

[course section description](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/04/expanded-i.png)

> Reminder: You can save schedule conflicts \(i\.e\. courses with overlapping meeting times\) but will need to resolve the conflict before registering\.

### Errors and alerts

If there are any errors or alerts in your saved schedule, they will appear in the top right corner, in an orange or a red box\. Select the box to view the descriptions for the errors and/or alerts\. 

-   **Red error:** You must resolve this error before you are able to save your saved schedule\. 
-   **Orange alerts:** You can save your saved schedule, but you will need to resolve this alert before registering\. 

[Example error and alerts](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/04/errors.png)

To view your alerts after exiting your saved schedule:

-   On the Workday homepage, select the “View My Saved Schedules” button\. 
-   If there are any alerts, they will appear under the “Alerts” column for the applicable saved schedule\. 
-   View the Resolving saved schedules alerts tutorial to find out how to manage and resolve alerts prior to registration\. 

## How to edit a saved schedule

1.  On the Workday homepage, click the “View My Saved Schedules” button\. 
2.  In the actions column for the saved schedule you want to change, select “Edit”\. **Do not** click “Remove”\. This will delete your entire saved schedule\. 
3.  Delete courses by clicking on the course section you want to remove and then select the trash can icon\. Remember to remove all associated activities for the course \(e\.g\. lab, discussion, etc\.\)\. 
4.  Add any new course sections\. 
5.  Select the “Save” button once you have finished making edits\. 

## How to register in courses from a saved schedule

### Before registering in courses

If you choose to register all your courses using a saved schedule, make sure to review and manage your saved schedule to resolve [alerts](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/managing-a-saved-schedule/), [conflicts](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/troubleshooting-your-course-registration/), and [holds on your record](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/resolving-a-hold-on-your-record/) before registration opens\. This can help prevent issues during your registration process\. 

### Navigate to a saved schedule

On the Workday homepage, select the “View My Saved Schedules” button\. 

### Register a saved schedule

**Reminder:** If registering for two terms, you must register for Term 1 before registering for Term 2\. 

1.  Click the “Register” button\.
    -   The button will only appear when registration opens for you\. 
2.  Make any last\-minute changes or resolve course conflicts before registering\. If you have unresolved course conflicts, you **will not** be registered in the conflicting courses\.  
3.  Once you are ready, click the “Register” button in the lower left corner\. Your registration will be processed in Workday\. 

### Review registration

After you complete your registration, a registration summary will appear on the screen in a table format\. The summary is divided into three sections: 

1.  **Unsuccessful registrations**:
    -   You were not registered in these courses\. Review the “Reason” column to find out why your registration was unsuccessful\. 
2.  **Waitlisted registrations**:
    -   You were added to the waitlist of these courses\. You may be offered a spot in the course if a seat becomes available\. Make sure your email address is correct in Workday to receive these messages\. 
    -   Learn how to [register in a course from the waitlist](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/registering-in-a-course-from-the-waitlist/)\.
3.  **Successful registrations**:
    -   You were successfully registered in these course sections\. Click the white “View Registered Courses” button in the lower left corner under the table summary for a complete list of your registered courses\. 

#### Register for Term 2

Once you have completed your registration for Term 1, [repeat the steps above](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/course-registration/creating-viewing-and-registering-from-a-saved-schedule/#saved-schedule) to register for Term 2\. 

### Additional resources

-   [Troubleshooting saved schedules](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/managing-a-saved-schedule/) 
-   [Understanding course waitlists](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/understanding-course-waitlists/)
-   [Joining, viewing, and registering from course waitlists](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/course-registration/joining-viewing-and-registering-from-course-waitlists/)

title: Troubleshooting saved schedules
content_markdown:
If you see an alert on your saved schedule, you may need to complete an action to avoid registration issues\.  

-   **Red errors:** You will not be able to proceed with your registration\. You must resolve the alert prior to registering for courses\. 
-   **Orange alerts:** You will be able to proceed with registration, but you should read the alert to ensure you meet the eligibility requirements\.

> **Before proceeding:**  
> When you are building **your Term 2 saved schedule**, you may see an alert that you do not meet the pre\-requisites for some courses\. This may be because you have the **pre\-requisites on your Term 1 saved schedule**\. Check your Term 1 saved schedules to make sure you have the required courses to meet your Term 2 pre\-requisites\.  
>   
> **This alert will be resolved after you register for your Term 1 courses\.** 

## View and resolve saved schedule alerts

### **Navigate to a saved schedule**

-   On the Workday homepage, select “View My Saved Schedules” button\. 
-   Click on the name of the saved schedule that you would like to view and resolve alerts for\. 
-   If your saved schedule has any issues, click the orange “Errors” box in the top right corner\. 
-   Review your alerts and take action to resolve them before you attempt registration\. 

The following table lists commonly encountered alerts and error messages, what they mean, and how you can resolve them\. 

- **Row 1**

  - **Header cell 1:**
  
    **Alert or Error Message**
  
  - **Header cell 2:**
  
    Issue
  
  - **Header cell 3:**
  
    Resolution

- **Row 2**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    “Your saved schedule includes course sections with time conflicts\.”
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    The time for a course in your saved schedule overlaps with another course\.
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    Remove one of the courses that has an overlapping schedule\.

- **Row 3**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    “Your saved schedule includes course sections that you’re not eligible for\.”
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    You do not meet eligibility requirements for a course in your saved schedule\.
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    Remove the course\. If you have coursework from a prior college or university that may meet the eligibility rules, please contact an [Enrolment Services Advisor](https://students.ubc.ca/about-student-services/enrolment-services-advisors) to discuss

- **Row 4**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    “Your saved schedule includes course sections you are not eligible for\.”
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    You do not meet the eligibility requirements for a course in your saved schedule\. You have not added a prerequisite course to your saved schedule\. A prerequisite course is a course you must take before the selected course\. If you do not add the prerequisite course in a term before your selected course, you will not meet the eligibility requirements set in Workday\.
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    Add the selected course in Term 2 and the prerequisite course in Term 1\.   
      
    When you register for your courses, you must register for Term 1 before Term 2 to meet the eligibility requirement\.

- **Row 5**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    “Your saved schedule includes course sections you are not eligible for\.”
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    You have not added a corequisite course to your saved schedule\. This may be due to a missing corequisite\. A corequisite is a course that you must take before or at the same time with the selected course\. If you do not add a corequisite, you will not meet the eligibility requirements set in Workday\.
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    If you are missing a corequisite \(found within the course eligibility rules\), add the corequisite course to your saved schedule\.

- **Row 6**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    “You’ve already received academic credit for \[Course\]\. Retaking it won’t count towards your overall credit requirements\.”
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    You have already received academic credit for the course section or an equivalent/cross\-listed course\.
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    You can still register for the course, but you will not receive credit for it\.

- **Row 7**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    “\[Instructional Format\] is required for \[Course\]\. Please select an \[Instructional Format\]”Example \| Discussion is required for ENGL\_V 112\. Please select a discussion\.
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    You are missing a required activity for the course\. For example, you have selected a lecture but not a discussion section\.
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    Go to the course on your saved schedule and select a section for each of the required instructional formats showing on the screen \(e\.g\., Lecture, Laboratory, Discussion, Seminar\)

- **Row 8**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    “You can’t register for a course section that overlaps with and belongs to the same course as another course section you’re already enrolled in\.”
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    You have already registered for that course for the academic period\.
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    Change or drop the course section you are currently registered in\. Note that you will lose your seat in the course section if you drop it\.

- **Row 9**

  - **Cell 1:**
  
    “There is already a \[Instructional Fromat\] section for \[Course\] under this saved schedule\. If you would like to change the section, remove the other section from your saved schedule\.”
  
  - **Cell 2:**
  
    This course activity has already been added to your saved schedule\. You now have multiple instances of the same course activity\.
  
  - **Cell 3:**
  
    Remove the course section from the saved schedule before adding a new course section\.

title: Joining, viewing, and registering from course waitlists
content_markdown:
For general information on course waitlists in Workday, view the understanding course waitlists tutorial\. To [add a waitlisted course to your saved schedule](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/creating-viewing-and-registering-from-a-saved-schedule/), follow these instructions\. 

## On this page

-   [How to join the waitlist for a course section](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/course-registration/joining-viewing-and-registering-from-course-waitlists/#join-waitlist) 
-   [How to view your waitlisted courses](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/course-registration/joining-viewing-and-registering-from-course-waitlists/#view-waitlist) 
-   [How to register in a course from the waitlist](https://workday.students.ubc.ca/course-registration/joining-viewing-and-registering-from-course-waitlists/#register-waitlist) 

## How to join the waitlist for a course section

### Navigate to the course schedule

Follow the instructions to view the [course schedule](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/viewing-the-course-schedule/)\.

### Select a course section

1.  Check that the course section has a waitlist\. 
2.  Click the course title to go to the “View Course Section” page\. 
    -   **Reminder:** To join the waitlist you must meet the course registration requirements\. 
3.  Click the “Register” button\. 

### Join the waitlist

1.  Click the **checkbox** in the “Select” column next to the course section\. 
    -   **Reminder:** If a course has multiple course activities \(e\.g\., a lecture and a lab\), the waitlist generally applies only to the **graded course activity** \(typically the lecture\)\. 
2.  Click the “Register” button\. 
3.  Review the confirmation page\. The course you selected will appear in a “Waitlisted Courses” table\. 

## How to view your waitlisted courses

### Go to your waitlisted courses

1.  On the Workday homepage, click the “View My Courses” button\. 
2.  Scroll down to the “My Waitlisted Courses” table\. 
    -   The “My Waitlisted Courses” table includes course sections for all terms of an academic session\. For example, if you are viewing the Winter Session, the “My Waitlisted Courses” table will include waitlists for both Term 1 and Term 2\. Review the “Start Date” and “End Date” to see which term the course falls in\. 

## How to register in a course from the waitlist

The waitlist process varies depending on which department is offering the course\. 

If you are waitlisted for a course, you will receive an email invitation to register if a seat becomes available\. 

In most cases, you will only have 24 hours to accept the seat before it goes to the next student on the waitlist\. Make sure to monitor your email frequently and [ensure your email address is correct](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/personal-information/updating-your-contact-information/) in Workday\. 

Follow the steps below to accept your seat, deny your seat but remain on the waitlist, or remove yourself from the waitlist\. 

> **If you receive an email notification directly from a UBC staff member**, you must follow the instructions that they provide to accept your seat within the course\. 

### View your waitlist task

1.  In Workday, click the “My Tasks” inbox icon\. 
2.  Select the message with the subject line “Course Opening Available”\. 

### Respond to the seat availablity

From the “My Tasks” message, you can take the following actions:

-   Click “Submit” to accept your seat\.
-   Click “Deny” to decline your seat \(but remain on the waitlist\)\.
-   Click “Remove from Waitlist” to leave the waitlist\.

[Remove from waitlist](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/05/remove-from-waitlist.png)

#### Accept your seat

1.  Click the “Submit” button\. 
2.  Scroll down and select all the required course activities from the “Select Course Sections” table by checking the boxes\. 
3.  3\. If you’ve already registered for the maximum number of credits for the term, or you have a conflicting course section, you can drop a course now to make space for your waitlisted course\. If you do not need to drop a course at this time, proceed to step 4\. 
    -   Click the “Drop Registered Courses” tab\. 
    -   Click the **checkbox** in the “Drop” column for the course you want to drop\.

[Drop registered courses](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/files/2026/05/drop-registered-courses.png)

4\. Click the “Submit” button\. A pop\-up notification with the heading, “You have submitted”, will appear under the search bar\.   
5\. In the notification, click the “View Details” link\.   
6\. Click the arrow next to “Details and Processes” to expand the section and view a confirmation of your enrolment\. 

#### Deny the seat \(and stay on the waitlist\)

1.  Click the “Deny” button\. 
2.  Enter your reason for denying the offer in the “Reason” field\. 
3.  Click the “Submit” button\. 
4.  A pop\-up notification with the heading, “You have submitted”, will appear under the search bar\. 
5.  In the notification, click the “View Details” link\. 
6.  Click the arrow next to “Details and Processes” to expand the section and view a confirmation that you have denied an available seat on the waitlist\. 

#### Remove yourself from the waitlist

1.  Click the “Remove From Waitlist” button\. 
2.  Click the **checkbox** next to “Confirm”\. 
3.  Click the “OK” button\. You will see a confirmation message if you have successfully removed yourself from the waitlist\. 

## Additional resources

-   [Understanding course waitlists](https://student-workday-2024.sites.olt.ubc.ca/course-registration/understanding-course-waitlists/)
